rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=3.5, img_sy=3.5, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-13, ONE-KNOB change vs the iter-12 base (the current breast CHAMPION: SSIM 0.974822, PSNR 38.63 dB; img_sx=img_sy=2.5, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, n_iter=300). KNOB: image-domain BF SPATIAL sigmas img_sx AND img_sy 2.5 -> 3.5 (isotropic WIDEN, one more step along the same axis). NUMBERS (six-box, not pixels): iter-11 (img_sx 1.5->0.5 TIGHTEN) 0.974719 FLAT; iter-12 (img_sx/img_sy 1.5->2.5 WIDEN) 0.974822 = tiny +0.0001 lift over the iter-8 peak 0.974749. So the WIDEN direction is the only one of the two spatial directions that produced ANY positive delta, but only marginally. WHY NOT img_kernel 5->7 (the route the dispatch brief floated from the demo subagent): the BREAST solver CONFIG default img_kernel is ALREADY 7 (solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.py CONFIG line: 'img_kernel: 7'), NOT 5. The demo subagent's 'img_kernel=5 caps the spatial sigma, so 5->7 unlocks it' finding is DEMO-SPECIFIC and does not transfer: breast was never at kernel 5, and breast iter-6 ALREADY tested img_kernel 7->9 and got 0.9731 FLAT (widening the window past 7 did nothing). So on breast the kernel is demonstrably NOT the cap. That foreclosed Route A, so I take the brief's explicit alternative (push img_sx/img_sy 2.5->3.5). FAILURE MODE / HYPOTHESIS: on the DEMO bilateral the img-spatial sigma climbed MONOTONICALLY (1.5->2.5->3.5: 0.7796->0.7940->0.8035, +0.014 then +0.0095), but on breast 1.5->2.5 gave only +0.0001 at the SAME kernel=7 window. Two competing explanations: (a) breast's tighter real-mu fibroglandular tissue simply does not share demo's coarse-phantom spatial-widen headroom -- the BF is already at its breast representational ceiling ~0.9748; OR (b) the same 2.5 sigma is still mostly inside the 7x7 (+-3px) window so the lever has barely engaged, and a sharper 3.5 push (closer to / past the effective window edge) is needed to see whether breast climbs the way demo did. iter-13 distinguishes these: if SSIM > 0.974822 (esp. by >0.0005), breast DOES share demo's spatial-widen direction and img_sx/img_sy is the live lever (next: 3.5->4.5, or revisit img_kernel 7->9 NOW that a wider sigma needs a wider window); if FLAT (within +-0.0005 of 0.9748) or DROPS, the image-spatial-sigma axis is CONFIRMED exhausted on breast at kernel=7 -- the ~0.9748 12-param breast bilateral structural ceiling holds across RANGE (img_sr/proj_sr), DEPTH (img_n_bf/proj_n_bf), KERNEL (img_kernel), OPTIMIZATION (n_iter) and the FULL spatial-sigma sweep (0.5/1.5/2.5/3.5), and the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view breast FBP. WALL: image-domain BF spatial cost is INDEPENDENT of the sigma VALUE (same kernel size, same unfold); step budget IDENTICAL to iter-12 (n_iter=300, val_n=16; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-12 ran 497 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged. ONE knob changed: img_sx 2.5->3.5 AND img_sy 2.5->3.5 (isotropic spatial sigma, a single coupled lever as in iter-12).
